column1: # Game profile of Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.2.2 = v262144). In bring-up: on the Mac 3D World reaches World 1-1 and Bowser's Fury its open world
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl, NintendoWare G3d / Ui2d / Vfx / Atk), SDK 10.4.0, NVN; RomFS is almost entirely Yaz0-compressed SARC archives (.szs).
# Shaders: bfsha (BNSH) and agl sharcb (BAHS) in ShaderData/*.szs, particle effects in EffectData (BNSH), a few layouts in LayoutData (BNSH), SystemData/AglResource.szs (BAHS)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# the virtual gamepad starts in the 3D layout (D-pad, right stick, L3 / R3): the right stick turns the camera
# only the merged 1.2.2 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed

# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. main's bss is only about 7 MB. Starts from 13 Sentinels' partition (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region) until measured
